"},{"name":"commonmark_lenient_headings_broad_links","code":"import re

_HEADING_RE = re.compile(r'^ {0,3}(#{2,6})[ \t]+(.*?)[ \t]*#*[ \t]*$')
_FENCE_RE = re.compile(r'^ {0,3}(`{3,}|~{3,})')


def _count_subheadings(text: str) -> int:
    count = 0
    in_fence = False
    fence_char = None
    for line in text.splitlines():
        m = _FENCE_RE.match(line)
        if m:
            ch = m.group(1)[0]
            if not in_fence:
                in_fence = True
                fence_char = ch
            elif ch == fence_char:
                in_fence = False
                fence_char = None
            continue
        if in_fence:
            continue
        hm = _HEADING_RE.match(line)
        if hm and hm.group(2).strip().strip('#').strip():
            count += 1
    return count


def _has_link(text: str) -> bool:
    lowered = text.lower()
    # Bare URL markers
    if re.search(r'\b(?:https?|ftp)://', lowered):
        return True
    if 'www.' in lowered:
        return True
    if re.search(r'\bmailto:', lowered):
        return True
    # Inline markdown links / images: [text](target)
    if re.search(r'!?\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)', text):
        return True
    # Autolinks: <scheme:...>
    if re.search(r'<[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+.\-]{1,31}:[^\s<>]+>', text):
        return True
    # Reference-style link definitions: [ref]: target
    if re.search(r'(?m)^ {0,3}\[[^\]]+\]:\s*\S+', text):
        return True
    # Reference-style usage: [text][ref] (only if a matching definition exists
    # would it render, but treat any explicit [x][y] as a link attempt)
    if re.search(r'\[[^\]]+\]\[[^\]]*\]', text):
        return True
    return False


def evaluate(output: str, inputs: dict) -> bool:
    """CommonMark-aware interpretation.

    - Subheadings: ATX headings of level 2-6, allowing up to 3 leading spaces
      and optional closing hashes, with non-empty text, outside fenced code.
      Need at least two.
    - Links: any URL scheme marker, 'www.', mailto:, inline links/images,
      autolinks, or reference-style links/definitions.
    """
    if not isinstance(output, str) or not output.strip():
        return False
    if _count_subheadings(output) < 2:
        return False
    if _has_link(output):
        return False
    return True

_SUBHEAD_RE = re.compile(r'^(#{2,3}) +(\S.*?)\s*$')


def evaluate(output: str, inputs: dict) -> bool:
    """Structural interpretation: subheadings must actually divide content.

    - Count only level-2/3 headings ('## ' or '### ' at column 0) whose text
      contains at least two alphanumeric characters.
    - Require at least two DISTINCT subheading texts (case-insensitive).
    - Require that at least two subheadings are followed by some non-heading,
      non-blank body text (i.e., they actually introduce a chunk) -- except the
      final subheading may be the last thing before truncation only if the
      first condition holds for two others.
    - Links: case-insensitive 'http://' / 'https://', a word-boundary 'www.',
      or a Markdown inline link whose target looks like a URL/path
      ([text](something-without-spaces)).
    """
    if not isinstance(output, str) or not output.strip():
        return False

    lines = output.splitlines()
    heading_idx = []
    distinct = set()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        m = _SUBHEAD_RE.match(line)
        if not m:
            continue
        text = m.group(2).strip().rstrip('#').strip()
        if len(re.findall(r'[A-Za-z0-9]', text)) < 2:
            continue
        heading_idx.append(i)
        distinct.add(re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text.lower()))

    if len(heading_idx) < 2 or len(distinct) < 2:
        return False

    # Check that headings introduce body content
    with_body = 0
    for n, idx in enumerate(heading_idx):
        end = heading_idx[n + 1] if n + 1 < len(heading_idx) else len(lines)
        body = [l for l in lines[idx + 1:end] if l.strip() and not l.lstrip().startswith('#')]
        if body:
            with_body += 1
    if with_body < 2:
        return False

    # Link detection
    if re.search(r'https?://', output, flags=re.IGNORECASE):
        return False
    if re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z0-9])www\.', output, flags=re.IGNORECASE):
        return False
    # Inline markdown link or image with a non-empty, space-free target
    if re.search(r'!?\[[^\]\n]*\]\(\s*[^\s)]+(?:\s+"[^"]*")?\s*\)', output):
        return False

    return True
